# FrontForumFocus

> FrontForumFocus builds Impact Brain: an app that turns what you did into proof. Type an activity, get its impact across the 17 UN SDGs. Runs on your phone, no cloud.

## About
- [Home](https://frontforumfocus.com/): The FrontForumFocus landing page and value proposition.
- [Products](https://frontforumfocus.com/products): Impact App (Impact Brain) — philosophy, calculator, trust, and beta download.
- [Podcast](https://frontforumfocus.com/podcasts): Conversations with founders and builders shaping the impact economy.
- [Community](https://frontforumfocus.com/community): Join the frontforumfocus community.
- [Impact Intelligence](https://frontforumfocus.com/impact-intelligence): Articles and insights on impact measurement.
- [Use Cases](https://frontforumfocus.com/use-cases): How Impact Brain is used.
- [For Founders](https://frontforumfocus.com/for-founders): Impact Brain for freelancers and founders.
- [Our Story](https://frontforumfocus.com/our-story): The story behind FrontForumFocus.

## Product: Impact Brain
- [Download APK (Android)](https://frontforumfocus.com/impact-brain.apk): Free beta. Runs on your phone, no cloud, no accounts.

## What it does
- Translates any activity into a score across the 17 UN SDGs.
- Scores four dimensions: economic, social, environmental, and time (time = money: hours × your rate).
- Every result includes a confidence score.
- Rules are open and inspectable; scores are bounded (-100 to 100).
- Inputs are your own words and your own hours — nothing is estimated behind your back.

## Who it is for
- Freelancers and founders: prove your value to clients and collaborators.
- Individual contributors: track and grow real impact toward goals.
- Mission-driven organizations: demonstrate measurable impact.
